title: Honey and Ginger Semifreddo
changes_from_base: Honey and fresh ginger sweeten and flavour the egg base instead of sugar and vanilla; crystallised ginger replaces the jam swirl.
summary: A chilled dessert featuring the floral notes of mild honey and the sharp warmth of fresh and crystallised ginger.

ingredients.item: mild honey (such as orange blossom or acacia)

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Prepare a 22 x 11 cm loaf tin with cling film. Leave enough overhang at the edges to cover the top later.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Fill a medium saucepan with 3-5 cm water and bring it to a simmer. Place the heatproof bowl over the pan without letting it touch the water.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the 1 large egg, 4 large egg yolks, 150 g honey and 2 tbsp grated ginger until pale and thick. Ensure the mixture reaches 71 °C but do not overheat to avoid curdling.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Remove the bowl from the heat and set the egg mixture aside to cool. This step ensures the cream does not melt when combined.

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk 320 ml double cream just until stiff peaks form. Use a whisk or hand mixer for a light texture.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Use a silicone spatula to fold the egg mixture into the cream. Pour into the tin, cover with the film and freeze for at least 3 h until solid.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Unmould onto a chilled plate and scatter half the 30 g crystallised ginger. Slice quickly and scatter the remaining ginger over the individual plates.

tips: Use orange blossom or acacia honey for a delicate flavour profile.
Ensure the bowl does not touch the simmering water to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Chill your serving plates in advance to help the slices hold their shape longer.
storage: Wrap well and keep in the freezer up to 2 weeks; slice straight from the freezer with a hot, dry knife.
